display.title: Episode 215: The Secret of Toras Emes, Chapter 2 (Shabbos Mevarchim Adar II)
display.summary_short: Before Shabbos Mevarchim Adar Sheini, Uncle Yossi explains the molad; a girl says the Shema; a dream saves the Jews from Ivan's plot; and the 'My Sefer Torah' drawing contest begins.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Shabbos Mevarchim for Adar Sheini in a leap year. Uncle Yossi explains how the moon grows from a thin line to a full disc, and how our Sages' calendar tells the exact moment of the molad, which will be announced in shul that Shabbos. As Dovid HaMelech wrote, 'the heavens tell the glory of Hashem', and studying them brings yiras Shamayim; a leap year brings a double portion of joy in Adar. After the Hakochainik march, a second-grade girl recites the Shema. The story 'The Secret of Toras Emes' concludes: on the night before the king's visit, the rabbi dreams three times of a voice calling 'Toras Emes, a real Torah', discovers the empty Torah, and quietly replaces it. Just as Haman fell into his own trap, Ivan's plot turns against him. Uncle Yossi then presents the new Tzivos Hashem newsletter and launches the 'My Sefer Torah' drawing contest, following the lessons on honoring holy books.
display.lesson: Hashem watches over the Jewish people, and a plot against them can turn back on the one who made it.
